Question: Assalam alaikum mufti sahab, If supposed we missed 3 rakah of Johar or Isha of 4 rakah farz and joined last rakaht,do I need to recite the surah Fatiha and other surah in 3rd and 4th rakat or just recite Surah Fatih and go for sujood. Jazaka Allahu qairun Answer ID: 19235 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 155/155/M=1431) In last rak?at i.e. the third rak?at of the three that were missed, you will have to recite Surah Fatihah and then perform ruku?. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
